user.title: Install Klimastatistik
user.description:
This bootstrap installs the private Klimastatistik integration from {repository}.

It requires a GitHub token that may read exactly this repository ({permission}). Write permission is not required and should not be granted.

Without valid permission nothing is downloaded and nothing is installed. The token is never logged, never exported and never shown in error messages.

reauth_confirm.title: Renew the GitHub token
reauth_confirm.description: The token for {repository} is no longer accepted. Please enter a valid token with {permission}.

error.cannot_connect: GitHub cannot be reached. This is a network problem, not a permission problem.
error.invalid_auth: The token was rejected. It is invalid, expired or revoked.
error.no_repository_access: The token is valid but has no read permission for this private repository. Installation is therefore not possible.
error.rate_limit: The GitHub request quota is exhausted. Please try again later.
error.release_not_found: No installable release was found in the selected channel.
error.asset_not_found: The release is missing a required file.
error.checksum_mismatch: The checksum of the downloaded package does not match. The installation was aborted.
error.integrity_error: The integrity check of the package failed. The installation was aborted.

abort.already_configured: The bootstrap is already set up.

confirm_restart.title: Restart required
confirm_restart.description: The private Klimastatistik integration {version} has been installed. Home Assistant must be restarted so that it is loaded. Klimastatistik can then be set up under Devices and services.

handover_pending.title: Set up Klimastatistik
handover_pending.description: The private Klimastatistik integration {version} is ready but not set up yet. Please add the Klimastatistik integration under Settings, Devices and services. The token you already entered is taken over automatically; the bootstrap then removes its copy of the token.
